title: Concept: Server filesystem path in an error
description: An absolute deployment path inside an error message in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The path reveals the operating system, the web root and the release directory name, which tells an attacker where to aim a traversal or an upload.
applicability: Deployments that render an absolute deployment path inside an error message into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The path reveals the operating system, the web root and the release directory name, which tells an attacker where to aim a traversal or an upload.
